   "id": "69df8eeb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Demo: mooring processing pipeline\n",
    "\n",
    "End-to-end mooring processing with the shipped `oceanarray.pipeline.process`\n",
    "entry point, run on the committed `dune2_1_2026` test fixture so this notebook\n",
    "reproduces from a clean checkout — no external data or mounted drive needed.\n",
    "\n",
    "The pipeline stages:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Stage 1** — raw instrument files → CF-NetCDF (`_stage1.nc`), faithful to raw.\n",
    "2. **Stage 2** — trim to the deployment window + linear clock-drift correction (`_stage2.nc`).\n",
    "3. **Stage 3** — QC flags, pressure interpolation, BEAM→ENU rotation + magnetic\n",
    "   declination, derived variables (`_stage3.nc`).\n",
    "4. **Stack** — interpolate every instrument onto a common time grid (`_stack.nc`).\n",
    "5. **Grid** — interpolate the stack onto a regular pressure grid (`_grid.nc`).\n",
    "\n",
    "`dune2_1_2026` is a two-instrument mooring (a SeaBird MicroCAT and a Nortek Aquadopp)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "bf7ab1d6",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-25T11:12:30.708221Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-25T11:12:30.708140Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-25T11:12:31.922583Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-25T11:12:31.922069Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [

    "import tempfile\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import xarray as xr\n",
    "\n",
    "from oceanarray.pipeline import process\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"default\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d1e85400",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Set up a scratch workspace\n",
    "\n",
    "The committed fixtures are read-only inputs. We copy the mooring YAML into a\n",
    "temporary processing directory and run the pipeline there, reading the raw\n",
    "instrument files straight from the fixture tree."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "01e0687e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-25T11:12:31.924209Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-25T11:12:31.923997Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-25T11:12:31.927230Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-25T11:12:31.926842Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "raw inputs : /home/runner/work/oceanarray/oceanarray/tests/fixtures/raw\n",
      "proc (scratch): /tmp/demo_mooring_aae_hpp8\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "repo_root = Path.cwd() if (Path.cwd() / \"tests\").is_dir() else Path.cwd().parent\n",
    "raw_dir = (repo_root / \"tests/fixtures/raw\").resolve()          # parent of dune2_1_2026/\n",
    "proc_fixture = (repo_root / \"tests/fixtures/proc/dune2_1_2026\").resolve()\n",
    "mooring_name = \"dune2_1_2026\"\n",
    "\n",
    "scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=\"demo_mooring_\"))\n",
    "(scratch / mooring_name).mkdir(parents=True)\n",
    "shutil.copy(proc_fixture / f\"{mooring_name}.mooring.yaml\", scratch / mooring_name)\n",
    "print(f\"raw inputs : {raw_dir}\")\n",
    "print(f\"proc (scratch): {scratch}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0980f332",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Run the pipeline\n",
    "\n",

    "`\"stack\"` and `\"grid\"` takes the mooring from raw files to a pressure-gridded product\n",
    "in one call. (With no `stage=`, `process` runs all five stages by default.)"
   ]

   "source": [
    "## The stacked product\n",
    "\n",
    "`_stack.nc` holds every instrument on one time axis, stacked along `N_LEVELS`\n",
    "(ordered deep-first). Each level keeps its own pressure record."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "2d265022",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.348187Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.348062Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.456915Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.456397Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "dims: {'time': 19635, 'N_LEVELS': 2}\n",
      "variables: ['temperature', 'temperature_qc', 'salinity', 'salinity_qc', 'conductivity', 'pressure', 'pressure_qc', 'east_velocity', 'north_velocity', 'up_velocity', 'current_speed', 'current_direction', 'east_velocity_qc', 'north_velocity_qc', 'up_velocity_qc', 'heading', 'pitch', 'roll', 'sigma0', 'velocity_flag', 'tilt_from_pressure', 'tilt_pressure_ref_hab', 'tilt_pressure_ref_serial', 'serial_number', 'InstrDepth', 'clock_offset', 'start_time', 'end_time', 'clock_drift_seconds', 'magnetic_declination', 'SENSOR_TEMP_2941', 'SENSOR_CNDC_2941']\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "out = scratch / mooring_name\n",
    "stack = xr.open_dataset(out / f\"{mooring_name}_stack.nc\", engine=\"netcdf4\", decode_timedelta=False)\n",
    "print(\"dims:\", dict(stack.sizes))\n",
    "print(\"variables:\", list(stack.data_vars))\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "for lev in range(stack.sizes[\"N_LEVELS\"]):\n",
    "    serial = str(stack[\"serial\"].values[lev]) if \"serial\" in stack else f\"level {lev}\"\n",
    "    ax.plot(stack[\"time\"], stack[\"temperature\"].isel(N_LEVELS=lev), lw=0.6, label=f\"s/n {serial}\")\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"time\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"temperature (degree_Celsius)\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(f\"{mooring_name} — stacked temperature\")\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "df9a7e34",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## The pressure-gridded product\n",
    "\n",
    "`_grid.nc` interpolates the stack onto a regular pressure axis — a `(time, pressure)`\n",
    "field per variable, ready for sectioning."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "0028f61e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.457968Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.457853Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.823541Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-25T11:12:33.823042Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "dims: {'time': 19635, 'pressure': 41}\n",
      "variables: ['temperature']\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x400 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "grid = xr.open_dataset(out / f\"{mooring_name}_grid.nc\", engine=\"netcdf4\", decode_timedelta=False)\n",
    "print(\"dims:\", dict(grid.sizes))\n",
    "print(\"variables:\", list(grid.data_vars))\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "m = ax.pcolormesh(grid[\"time\"], grid[\"pressure\"], grid[\"temperature\"].T, shading=\"auto\")\n",
    "ax.invert_yaxis()\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"time\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"pressure (dbar)\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(f\"{mooring_name} — gridded temperature\")\n",
    "fig.colorbar(m, ax=ax, label=\"temperature (degree_Celsius)\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "stack.close()\n",
    "grid.close()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cd6a060a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The same five stages run on any mooring with a `*.mooring.yaml` and raw instrument\n",
    "files laid out under `raw_dir`; point `raw_dir`/`proc_dir` at a cruise tree to process\n",
    "real data."
   ]
  }
